section.p: We choose and make every Organicopia product with care, and we want you to love what you receive. If you are not satisfied with a product for any reason, please tell us within 7 days of delivery. Message us on WhatsApp or reply to your order email, and we will make it right with a replacement.
If something arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, send us a photo and we will replace it at no cost to you.
We will arrange to collect the item from you when we bring your replacement.
Thank you for trusting us with what goes on your table.
